property_summary: After any caller (possibly not the current owner) invokes setOwner, the reference contract's owner should only change when the caller is the existing owner; the mutant allows any caller to change owner, so after the same sequence of calls the reference and mutant will differ in their owner values.
change_summary: Change the require condition in the modifier to a tautology, e.g., 'require(true);', so the modifier never reverts.
